output.summary: The user requires Year-1 realized gross compensation of at least $260,000. The packet lists a base salary of $205,000 and a guaranteed signing bonus of $10,000. The equity grant is $400,000 total, with 25% vesting at the 12-month cliff. Calculating the Year-1 equity value: 25% of $400,000 equals $100,000. Summing these components: $205,000 (base) + $10,000 (signing) + $100,000 (equity) equals $315,000. This total exceeds the $260,000 threshold. The discretionary bonus is excluded as it is not guaranteed. All stated constraints are satisfied.
